backtest.summary: Backtest, every $1,000+ Kalshi taker print before 2,291 games (Sep 18 to Oct 14): the money won 0.9 points less often than the price it paid (±1.1), -2.9% a bet after the fee, and $25K+ prints did worst. So the money only tells you a fair-ish price; the edge is the gap to the app or book. Money on a market where the other side also traded (the market-maker label) did no worse than one-way money, so it is shown by default.
